description: This file defines the LuceneSearchEngine class, which extends SearchEngine to perform search operations using Lucene indexing within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for executing searches, caching results, and processing hits, with integration for access control and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: LuceneSearchEngine
classes.description: A search engine class that uses Lucene indexing to perform search queries within SuiteCRM, supporting caching, access control, and result parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Lucene index using BeanFactory.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query, measures execution time, and returns search results with total hits.

methods.name: runLucene
methods.description: Performs the actual Lucene search, utilizing cache if available and valid.

methods.name: validateCacheStructure
methods.description: Validates the structure of cached search hits.

methods.name: newHit
methods.description: Performs a new search using the index, applies access control, and caches the results.

methods.name: parseHits
methods.description: Parses raw hits into structured search results, applying pagination.

methods.name: cacheQuery
methods.description: Caches search results for a given query string.
